beforeSql:
SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
ORDER BY freight_value DESC NULLS LAST, order_id, order_item_id
LIMIT 5;
afterSql:
SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
ORDER BY freight_value DESC
LIMIT 5;

beforeSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(review_comment_title) <> '';
afterSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL
  AND review_comment_title <> '';

beforeSql:
SELECT member_id, points
FROM members
ORDER BY points DESC
LIMIT 10;
afterSql:
SELECT member_id, points
FROM members
ORDER BY points DESC NULLS LAST, member_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS adjusted_product_cnt
FROM product_price_history;

beforeSql:
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets
GROUP BY category_id
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT tc.category_name, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
GROUP BY tc.category_name
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT product_category_name
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(product_id) > 1500
ORDER BY COUNT(product_id) DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
afterSql:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id
LIMIT 10;

beforeSql:
SELECT ca.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
LEFT JOIN coupons c ON c.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id
ORDER BY ca.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;
afterSql:
SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
LEFT JOIN coupons c ON ca.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.product_category_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql:
SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS shipment_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS order_count
FROM shipments s
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT rl.level_name AS referrer_level,
       il.level_name AS invitee_level,
       COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
       ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward
FROM referrals r
JOIN members rm ON rm.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
JOIN member_levels rl ON rl.level_id = rm.level_id
JOIN members im ON im.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
JOIN member_levels il ON il.level_id = im.level_id
GROUP BY rl.level_name, il.level_name
ORDER BY referral_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT rm.level_id AS referrer_level_id,
       im.level_id AS invitee_level_id,
       COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
       ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward_amount
FROM referrals r
JOIN members rm ON rm.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
JOIN members im ON im.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
GROUP BY rm.level_id, im.level_id
ORDER BY referral_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
